If the engine is

equipped with an oil filter, the filter shall be constructed and installed in such a manner that complete blocking of | the flow through the filter element will not jeopardize the continued operation of the engine oil supply system.

If the powerplant installation incorporates an oil filter (strainer), the filter shall be constructed and installed so that oil will continue to flow at the normal rate through the remainder of the system when the flow of oil through the filter element is completely blocked. 31.
